A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Streaming-VR research. All 14 pages in each version, including figures, tables, equations and appendices, support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2.pdf reports original ASQA and QuoteSum experiments, including answer quality, token efficiency, latency, model comparisons and verifier accuracy.

after.justification: v3.pdf retains those original empirical results and adds a qualitative comparison of generated and refined answers in Appendix D.

M1.justification: Section 3's verification, refinement, training and answer-update procedures are unchanged. Figure 1's added update arrow depicts behavior already described in v2.pdf.

E1.justification: ASQA and QuoteSum coverage, including retrieval and few-shot scenarios, is unchanged. Appendix D's question about Foyle's War illustrates existing factual QA coverage without introducing a distinct task or test scenario.

E2.justification: Tables 1–5 retain the same comparators, including Full-VR, Self-VR, Self-RAG and the random verifier baseline. New Table 6 uses the existing comparison against unrefined LLaMA-3.1 8B and Full-VR.

E3.justification: Reported splits, retrieval settings, example counts, metrics and training settings are unchanged. The new case uses an existing generator/verifier/refiner combination and reports no revised evaluation protocol.

E4.justification: New Appendix D presents one case comparing original, Full-VR and Streaming-VR answers, highlighting errors and corrections. It supplements the unchanged model comparisons, retrieval/example sensitivity analyses and error-propagation analysis.

E5.justification: Existing statistical reporting, averages and plotted uncertainty displays are unchanged. Appendix D adds no run counts, seed information, uncertainty estimates or significance tests.

E6.justification: Table 6 adds three concrete answer texts, including Full-VR retaining 'BBC' while Streaming-VR uses 'ITV', and annotated spouse-name corrections. Existing numerical results in Tables 1–5 and Figures 2–4 are unchanged.

T1.justification: Section 3's formal definitions and Appendix C's latency assumptions, equations and derivation are unchanged. Appendix D introduces no mathematical results.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about real-time correction, reduced error propagation and improved efficiency while maintaining answer quality.

C2.justification: Appendix D newly attributes the original answer's problems to ambiguity and grammatical errors, claims Streaming-VR corrects every error in this example, and contrasts its preservation of answer structure with Full-VR's rewriting. Existing limitations are unchanged.

D1.justification: Appendix A's implementation details remain identical, including five training epochs, AdamW, learning rate 1e-5 and augmentation temperatures. Table 6 repeats existing model roles without adding implementation or resource-access information.

R1.justification: Related work and references are unchanged. The added case study introduces no citations or revision to the paper's positioning relative to prior research.

P1.justification: v3.pdf adds Appendix D and its explanatory paragraphs and updates an author's email address. The existing narrative, section order and Appendices A–C remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 1(b) gains an 'Update Answer' feedback arrow, and the final appendix page gains color-coded Table 6. Existing result tables and plots retain their displays and layout.

improvement.justification: The explicit update loop in Figure 1 and the original/refined outputs in Appendix D improve clarity and make the claimed editing behavior easier to inspect. These are modest explanatory gains: the single case has limited evidential weight, and the quantitative evaluation and existing limitations remain unchanged.
